{{Quote|I fought a Matukai&mdash;never again!|Thame Cerulian's notation in ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
A '''Matukai''' fought with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Thame Cerulian]]<ref name="TJP" /> by [[103 BBY]].<ref name="Cerulian">According to [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path'']], [[Thame Cerulian]] owned a copy of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' between [[115 BBY]] and [[103 BBY]]. Since Cerulian fought the Matuaki while in posession of the [[Book/Legends|book]], he must have fought against the Matuaki by 103 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> A member of the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] organization of [[Force Adept|Force adepts]] who used the physical body to channel [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the warrior proved to be a challenging opponent to Cerulian. Following the fight, the Padawan commented in his copy of the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' that he would "never again" want to face a Matukai in combat.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Matukai was mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="TJP" />
